The LiNbO3 coating layer can isolate the direct contact and impede the side reactions between the active materials and solid electrolytes in the cathode mixture at various cut-off voltages (3.6, 3.9 V, and 4.2 V), lowering the interfacial resistances. Therefore, introducing the LiNbO3 coating layer cannot lower the resistance increase.
